crossRefs.note: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to…
We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we…
Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s…
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men…
Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means…
No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of…
Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”

translations.web: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
translations.bsb: We who are strong ought to bear with the shortcomings of the weak and not to please ourselves.
translations.kjv: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
translations.asv: Now we that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
